2000CL / 2000DGL / 2000TCL / 2000OL: Cortech Rock and Rock 2.0 Food Tray Lid
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-lid-for-rock-and-rock-2-0-food-trays
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/food-service/correctional-food-trays/rock-tray/
Spec sheets: Rock Tray and lids, Rock 2.0 and lids
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Rock and Rock 2.0 Food Tray Lid
Current H1: Cortech Lid for Rock and Rock 2.0 Food Trays
Subtitle: Lid That Fits Both the Cortech Rock and Rock 2.0 Insulated Food Trays, in Four Colors
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 2000CL, 2000DGL, 2000TCL, 2000OL
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Rock and Rock 2.0 Food Tray Lid covers both the Cortech Rock and Rock 2.0 insulated food trays (sold separately), since the two trays have the same footprint. It keeps meals covered during delivery in prisons, jails, and other correctional facilities.
The lids come in the same four colors as the trays, and lidded trays stack in the Chuckwagon and Chuckwagon Jr. delivery carts.
Fit: Made for the Cortech Rock (2000) and Rock 2.0 (2500) trays
Cart Capacity: 96 Rock Trays or 84 Rock 2.0 Trays with lids in the Chuckwagon; 56 Rock Trays or 48 Rock 2.0 Trays with lids in the Chuckwagon Jr.
Colors: Brown, Dark Gray, Terracotta, or Orange (custom colors available on request)
Packaging: Sold in cases of 10
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
2000CL – Brown: Rock lid
2000DGL – Dark Gray: Rock lid
2000TCL – Terracotta: Rock lid
2000OL – Orange: Rock lid
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The Rock lid suits facilities that deliver meals on Rock or Rock 2.0 trays and need covered, stackable trays.
Typical applications include:
Inmate meal service in prisons, jails, and detention centers
Central kitchens that deliver meals to housing units
Juvenile detention and other secure facilities
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection for more food trays, delivery carts, and food service supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Food Service
Cortech food service products are made for high-volume meal service in correctional facilities, where trays, carts, and dispensers are used and washed every day. Cortech trays and delivery carts are sized to work together.
Cortech food service includes:
Insulated Food Trays: The Rock, Rock 2.0, Rock with Cor-Flex, and X-Tray, with matching lids
Tray Delivery Carts: The insulated Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., and Chuckwagon Max, and the non-insulated Tray Master
Beverage Service: The BevMax insulated beverage dispenser
Tray Drying: Aluminum meal tray drying racks
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (52 characters): Cortech Rock and Rock 2.0 Food Tray Lid at Anchortex
Meta description (145 characters): Shop the Cortech Rock Tray Lid. One lid fits both the Cortech Rock and Rock 2.0 insulated food trays, so lidded trays stack. Sold in cases of 10.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Food Service" is a new section for the food service pages (trays, lids, delivery carts, BevMax, and drying racks). It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: I put "Rock and Rock 2.0" first and "Lid" at the end, to match the other lid pages. There are four model numbers, so I left them out of the H1.
Tongue and groove seal: your current page says the lid has a "tongue and groove patent pending design." The Cortech spec sheets say this only for the X-Tray, so I left it out.
Weight and size: the Cortech spec sheet does not give a weight or size for the lids, so I left them out.
Warranty: the Cortech spec sheets give a 5-year warranty for the trays but do not say whether it covers the lids, so I left the warranty out.
Price: your current page says "Price is per piece" and "Sold 10 per case." Can you check whether your price is per lid or per case?
Variant names: your variants say "Chocolate Brown," "Dark Grey," and "Terra Cotta." The Cortech spec sheet says "Brown," "Dark Gray," and "Terracotta." Would you like them renamed, for example "2000CL - Brown"?
Collection link: I linked the Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection, which this product is already in.
Product images: the page has one image. The Cortech product page has three photos of the Rock lid in gray, orange, and brown. Would you like me to add them?
